methodological_caveats.subject_overlap_dependence: The 10 subject-wise partitions reuse the same 42 unique subjects (26 dev, 7 val, 9 test per partition). Observations across folds are statistically dependent, violating the independence assumption of paired Wilcoxon and paired t-tests.
methodological_caveats.exploratory_status: All hypothesis tests across partitions must be treated as exploratory descriptive diagnostics, never confirmatory proofs of statistical significance.
methodological_caveats.varying_target_thresholds: Each partition derives its binarization threshold tau strictly from its own development partition (ranging from 18.000 to 23.917). The classification tasks across seeds are clinically related but mathematically non-identical.
methodological_caveats.pooled_records_nature: The 12,678 pooled test instances represent repeated evaluations of records from 42 subjects across 10 splits, not 12,678 independent clinical observations.

reporting_recommendation: Per-seed results and ten-seed mean +/- standard deviation (with descriptive intervals) must remain the primary reporting format. Extra Trees is reported as the numerically strongest candidate without claiming proven statistical superiority.
